about: Why the library keeps the clips the sensors flag (PLAN.md WP-5.8; tools/qa/verdict.ts). The writers (npm run import, npm run migrate) record each clip's verdict in its quality: pass, or baselined with a reason that names the level and the metrics past it, then a reason given here for that clip and metric, else its set's, else the warn level's, else how the clip stands to its source (as captured or as keyed, its fit, what its repair did). npm run qa -- library --check reads every clip's again and names a reason here whose finding is gone.
warn: short of every fail level (thresholds.ts): unusual, not broken
